objective: Implement non-authoritative client replica presentation Node3D proxies for Atlas's Package 35 snapshots and handle retirement.
acceptance_criteria: Host-issued handles key presentation proxy identity independently of content_id.
Accepted ordered host snapshots update presentation-only transforms using the existing client replica state.
Retired handles dispose of the associated proxies and cannot gain simulation or persistence authority.
Focused changed-behavior checks execute where Godot is available, with explicit NOT RUN states otherwise.
